## `authorization-requests list`

Retrieves the list of Authorization Request with pagination (sorting and filtering)

```
epm-cli authorization-requests list [flags]
```

API: `GET /v3/AuthorizationRequest` · Response: `AuthorizationRequestListItemModel`

**Filters and parameters**

| Flag | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--sort FIELD[:asc\|desc]` | repeatable | | sort order, e.g. `--sort created:desc` |
| `--page-size` | integer |  | The number of records per page, for example 1. Shouldn't exceed 200. |
| `--page` | integer |  | The page number to retrieve from results, for example 1 |
| `--decision` | string |  | `Filter.Decision` |
| `--created-on` | string |  | `Filter.CreatedOn` |
| `--active-only` | switch |  | `Filter.ActiveOnly` |
| `--modified-on` | string |  | `Filter.ModifiedOn` |
| `--all`, `-A` | switch | | fetch every page |
| `--max-pages` | integer | | with `--all`: stop after N pages |

**Example**

```sh
epm-cli authorization-requests list --all -o json
```
